metadata.transformation_notes: Published model outputs and limited transformed comparisons; full source PortWatch panel and raw vessel positions are not redistributed.
notes: Current-vintage pseudo-real-time evaluation under assumed reporting lags; historical public availability is not verified.
Only 24 independent monthly test periods; model selection, data revisions and regime uncertainty remain.
Selected-gateway loaded-import TEUs are not total U.S. imports, consumer demand or investment returns.
NOAA cargo-vessel proxy and queue-candidate states are retrospective, coverage-limited measurements, not independently validated delay labels.
